questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Varmere vejr end Danmark, en by med mange muligheder og et sted hvor man føler sig tryg nok til at kunne gå rundt alene.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Den eneste grund til jeg ikke giver 10 er fordi det faglige var ret kedeligt, men det fyldte ikke særlig meget.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det var ret nemt.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Ingen. Havde fået det meste på mail før jeg ankom.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: Man kan vælge at få en mentor som viser en rundt og som man kan komme til hvis man har spørgsmål. Dog var det hele meget lige til, så jeg gjorde ikke rigtig brug af det.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Led i god tid. Jeg fandt en lejlighed gennem airbnb. Fordelen ved at gøre det gennem airbnb er at man ikke skal betale depositum.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Togturen til Uni tager ca. 38 min. fra centrum. Bo tæt på en station hvor toglinjen S2 går så man ikke skal skifte. Lad dig ikke skræmme af togturen. For det meste er undervisningen ikke obligatorisk, så det er ikke nødvendigt at møde hver dag.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg tilmeldte mig kurser online i starten af juli. Det er først til mølle princippet, men jeg fik alle de kurser jeg søgte.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Man får et login på mail og skal uploade sit pas, sygesikring og andre oplysninger.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Man kan ringe eller skrive på mail. Jeg synes de svarede rimelig hurtigt.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik alle de kurser jeg ville have.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Husk at checke eksamensdatoer (midterm og final) og tidspunkter for undervisning så det ikke overlapper.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Der var et okay udvalg af kurser.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: De fleste fag var ret nemme og dermed også lidt kedelige. Til gengæld var der for det meste ikke obligatorisk fremmøde og det kræver ikke så meget at bestå, så jeg havde god tid til at lave alt muligt andet end UNI. Gør det for oplevelsen af Barcelona og ikke det faglige.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: En blanding af forelæsninger, holdundervisning og gruppeprojekter. Minder en del om gymnasieundervisning.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Economic Policy (Makro III), Business Economics (valgfag), World Economic History (Økonomisk historie), Economic Development (prioriteret valgfag) og Microeconomics III (valgfag- pensum er stort set identisk med Mikro II).

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: De var alle ret kedelige og nemme, men en nem måde at få overstået fag på og det var rart ikke at være presset af uni.

Food DKK per month *

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Mine utallige cafébesøg, men ellers ikke rigtig noget.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Kaffe koster koster kun 13 kr. på mange caféer.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: De har gode idrætsfaciliteter på uni og abonnementet er ikke særlig dyrt. Tennisbaner, svømmehal, fitness osv.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg gjorde ikke brug af det.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Gå ud og spis, gå ture i byen, rejs til Marrakech, tag på stranden, tag toget til de nærliggende byer osv.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt. Spaniere er søde og imødekommende.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Jeg synes det var svært fordi ikke alle er så gode til engelsk og mange af dem jeg havde fag med var ca. 18 år. Det var nemmere at socialisere med andre udvekslingsstuderende.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Intet.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Gå-ud kulturen. Der er caféer, restauranter og barer alle vegne.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Vær åben. Tal med andre udvekslingsstuderende. Brug byen.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Det tager noget tid at føle sig tilpas et nyt sted. Der sker mange nye ting i starten som man godt kan blive overvældet af, men det er det hele værd at tage på udveksling.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At få en pause fra uni herhjemme. Hvis man er skoletræt så tag hertil. Det gør en kæmpe forskel at man kun skal bestå fagene og at ens karakterer ikke bliver overført.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Snakke engelsk hele tiden, men det vænner man sig hurtigt til.

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: Tag afsted! Lad dig ikke skræmme af togturen til uni. Den er hyggelig, og det er ikke nødvendigt at møde hver dag, selvom man ofte har undervisning hver dag.

questions.question: Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
